landing.insights.description: Faster insights with five new features

landing.description.message: An open-source React UI library delivering unstyled, behavior-first primitives. Zero styling opinions, full accessibility built-in. Install via npm and build your design system.
landing.description.description: Open-source library with unstyled, primitive components description

landing.workflow.description.message: Stop reinventing the wheel. Spar handles state management, accessibility, and keyboard interactions out of the box—so you can focus on what makes your product unique.

landing.styling.description.message: No more fighting with opinionated styles. Our headless components give you complete design freedom while handling the complex behavior and accessibility under the hood.

features.wai.aria.description.message: Built on WAI-ARIA standards from day one. Spar ensures semantic correctness and proper behavior for assistive technologies.
features.wai.aria.description.description: Spar follows WAI-ARIA best practices description

features.keyboard.description.message: Complete keyboard support with tab, arrow keys, enter/escape—all interactions work exactly as users expect, out of the box.
features.keyboard.description.description: All Spar components support full keyboard interaction description

features.focus.description.message: Focus management that works predictably by default, with full customization options for complex UI flows and modal interactions.
features.focus.description.description: Focus management works as expected by default description

features.screen.reader.description.message: Rigorously tested with NVDA, VoiceOver, and JAWS to prevent common accessibility pitfalls and ensure consistent behavior.
features.screen.reader.description.description: Tested across major screen readers description

aidriven.description.message: Pre-configured GitHub Copilot instructions and prompts in .github folder ensure consistent, team-aligned AI assistance throughout your development workflow.
aidriven.description.description: Support for error-free and rapid development processes with artificial intelligence assistance
